about.title: What is K-Digital Training?
about.body: Innovative private training providers, leading digital companies and top universities take part as training institutions, offering a wide range of courses so you can learn core technologies such as AI and big data, plus applied fields like fintech, cloud and smart manufacturing, and put them to use in practice (tuition support and training allowances provided).
